name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.0.2: kiosk-owned stock for coil machines. New coil machines now default stockSource to kiosk (fridges stay weimi since they weigh stock). The correctness-critical decrement path already existed and is confirmed correct: a successful vend (status 1) decrements the served planogram via applySaleToLayout with a stale-vend timestamp guard and clamp-at-zero; failed/refunded vends do not decrement. Restock writes to the same layout map config serves, and the config stock map is read from that same source, so sales, restocks and config are one source of truth. Weimi counts are ignored (not reconciled) when stockSource is kiosk. Cumulative over v6.0.1.
